title: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner
sourceTitle: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner
author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge
description: "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner" by Samuel Taylor Coleridge is a poem written in 1797–98.
longDescription: A weathered sailor stops a wedding guest to share his haunting tale of a sea voyage gone terribly wrong. After shooting an albatross, the mariner faces supernatural punishment and watches his crew perish.

authorInfo.bio: Samuel Taylor Coleridge  was an English poet, literary critic, philosopher, and theologian who was a founder of the Romantic Movement in England and a member of the Lake Poets with his friend William Wordsworth. He also shared volumes and collaborated with Charles Lamb, Robert Southey, and Charles Lloyd.
